title: Omnipresence of God
definition: The omnipresence of God means that God is fully present everywhere, not limited by space or distance.
summary: God is present everywhere and near to His people.
christFocus: Jesus promised to be with His people always, and through the Spirit God dwells with believers.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's omnipresence means no place is outside His presence. He is not spread thin, divided, or confined. He is fully present wherever He chooses to act and reveal Himself.

For the rebellious, this is sobering because no sin is hidden from God. For the suffering and lonely, it is deeply comforting because no place is abandoned by Him.

In Christ, God's nearness becomes saving and personal. Believers are not merely observed by God; they are welcomed, kept, and indwelt by His Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Loneliness, fear, exile, or suffering can make people feel abandoned. The omnipresence of God matters because God's people are never outside His sight or care.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Remember God's presence in ordinary places and painful places. Pray wherever you are, and comfort others with the truth that God is not far from His people.
